text:
Alice: Heads-up — landing at 11:20, got a 30min window for lunch near FiDi. Quick question: sushi conveyor or bento for fastest, clean-ish option? :airplane:
Raj: SushiGiri on Market — conveyor, really speedy, cashless only, usually 8–12 min if line short. :sushi:
Mei: BentoBox (Montgomery) is great — prepay online, two-compartment trays, decent salad + mains, veggie options. Order ahead and grab. :leafy_green:
Javier: If you need 30m, avoid 12:00 exactly. Try to call ahead or use pickup app and choose "skip the queue" where available.
Alice: Heard bank & Sutter sushi counter wraps bento nicely. Anyone confirm?
Raj: Bank & Sutter counter is solid for takeout, they fold it tight. But lines spike at 12:05, so get there by 11:50.
FoodBot: Quick curated list: SushiGiri (conveyor), BentoBox (pickup), BankSushi (counter), MisoFast (udon/bento). Link: https://short.url/sf-fidi-eats — use the 30m prep filter.
Mei: Pro tip: bring a couple of napkins/hand wipes — FiDi lunch tables tend to be messy. :grimacing:
Javier: If you want non-sushi, MisoFast bento-style udon bowls are ready in ~7 min. Saved my schedule last week. :ramen:
Alice: Awesome, ordering BentoBox pickup now. Will ping if flight runs late. Thanks! :thumbsup:
